programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor tells the story of the early canal builders who struggled with the rugged terrain of England's Pennine hills. Creating a network of canals in this landscape was a major challenge, but connecting the powerhouses of Yorkshire and Lancashire was a great incentive at the time of the Industrial Revolution. Liz considers the strategic considerations and implications of this massive engineering project

programme.title: Britain's Lost Masterpieces
programme.desc: British art detectives Bendor Grosvenor and Emma Dabiri hunt for of the nation's great lost masterpieces. They uncover if a painting of a society woman is by artist Joshua Reynolds and discover which celebrity playwright will lead them from Rome to Bath to London's Royal Academy

programme.title: Earth's Seasonal Secrets
programme.desc: How animals and plants deal with the changes in the environment that occur every autumn. As summer ends, animals have to prepare for the winter ahead. Chipmunks and beavers hurry to hoard their winter supplies before the weather grows colder, while musk oxen and beetles find they only have one more chance to mate before the year is out and young gannets face the first dangerous challenge of their lives. Narrated by Andrew Scott

programme.title: Timothy Spall: Somewhere at Sea
programme.sub-title: The Luck of the Irish Sea
programme.desc: The actor and his wife Shane embark on a journey from Cardiff to Clydebank in their barge the Princess Matilda. The first leg of the voyage begins smoothly as they travel to Milford Haven - but a bungled departure leaves them marooned en route to Fishguard. Shane also gets to make an emotional return to Aberystwyth, and the couple receive a pleasant surprise when they visit the coastal village of Porthdinllaen

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Audrey finds herself under suspicion after a valuable piece of DeVere's antique china mysteriously disappears while she helps him catalogue his collection. Comedy, starring Penelope Keith and Peter Bowles

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth volunteers to help with an OAP day-trip to the seaside, but her plans bring nothing but trouble, landing her in the arms of an amorous Italian pensioner. Patricia Routledge and Clive Swift star

programme.title: The Boleyns: A Scandalous Family
programme.desc: The docudrama telling the story of the rise and fall of the Boleyn family during the reign of Henry VIII concludes as Anne makes her play for the biggest prize in the kingdom. In doing so, she changes the course of British history, but the Boleyns have no idea of the high price they will have to pay

programme.title: The Three Kings
programme.desc: The story of how Matt Busby, Bill Shankly and Jock Stein, all born south of Glasgow within 30 miles of one another, grew up to become lifelong friends and three of the most influential men in football history. The programme reveals how they led Manchester United, Liverpool and Celtic from the doldrums to achieve unimaginable success, captivating millions of fans and becoming three of the most famous sporting institutions on the planet

programme.title: The Cult Next Door
programme.desc: The extraordinary story of a strange cult that came to light in 2013, when three women emerged from a small flat in Brixton, south London, after decades in captivity. The documentary traces the group back to its roots in the 1970s, when Aravindan Balakrishnan, who believed in an international communist revolution, created a tiny political sect that followed the teachings of China's Chairman Mao. However, his left-wing collective evolved into a pseudo-religious cult, in which members were controlled, threatened and brainwashed so that they were too terrified to leave

programme.title: Bullets, Boots and Bandages: How to Really Win at War
programme.desc: Military historian Saul David explains the importance of efficiently moving an army during wartime, as he continues his exploration of the often-overlooked logistical issues that can make a major difference to the outcomes of conflicts. He also examines how generals have approached the problem in the past

programme.title: The Boleyns: A Scandalous Family

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: Liz McIvor recounts the story of 'canal mania' - a boom period of frenzied activity that helped develop Britain's modern financial economy, now centred in London. The new canal capitalists made money by investing and speculating in waterways used to carry fuel and goods around the country. However, not all canals were profitable and investors soon discovered that such a venture created losers as well as winners

programme.title: Timothy Spall: Somewhere at Sea
programme.desc: The Princess Matilda sails into Liverpool, but Tim has a difficult time reaching shore as he struggles to navigate around tankers and ferries. The barge then heads to Glasson Dock in Lancashire, where the hapless actor has more trouble with buoys, before a misunderstanding results in Matilda spending a night stranded on the Irish Sea. Tim and Shane also visit Piel Island near Barrow-in-Furness, which has the unusual honour of having its own king and queen

programme.title: The Shaman's Grave
programme.desc: Researchers in Germany reopen an archaeological cold case from the Mesolithic period - the ancient grave of a woman and a child, whose circumstances of death are unknown. An exploration into the roots of human psychology and the beginnings of spirituality, aided by archaeogenetics and the latest medical research, help to unlock the mystery surrounding a Stone Age woman

programme.title: The Human Body: Secrets of Your Life Revealed
programme.desc: Chris and Xand van Tulleken explore the processes keeping human beings alive, seeing how powerful reflexes of fear and disgust keep people safe from danger and revealing the mechanisms bodies call on to repair damage. Xand visits one of the most advanced laboratories in the world to test his body's ability to maintain its inner balance, while Chris learns how scientists in Stockholm are trying to help people with phobias by investigating the neural mechanisms involved in fear and ways to control it

programme.title: Middlemarch
programme.desc: Ladislaw vows to leave Middlemarch once he learns the terms of Casaubon's will. Dr Lydgate's financial and marital problems worsen, while Fred declares his love for Mary Garth

programme.title: Middlemarch
programme.desc: The future looks bleak for the Lydgates as their marriage collapses and they descend into bankruptcy, but Raffles' return to Middlemarch shakes the community to its foundations. Dorothea casts aside her mourning garb in an attempt to make her life more worthwhile, and Fred is torn between his family and his beliefs

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Everything Is Connected: George Eliot's Life
programme.desc: Artist Gillian Wearing celebrates the legacy of Victorian novelist George Eliot. Just as Eliot's novel Middlemarch explored the lives of ordinary men and women, this experimental film is made up of a diverse cast of people from different backgrounds, and features Jason Isaacs and Sheila Atim as the narrators

programme.title: Lee Miller: A Life on the Front Line
programme.desc: Lee Miller is one of the most remarkable female icons of the 20th century. A fashion model-turned-photographer, then later a war reporter, Miller chose to live life by her own rules. This documentary drama celebrates a subject who defied anyone who tried to pin her down, put her on a pedestal or pigeonhole her in any way. Often at odds with the morality of the day, she refused to be subjugated by the dominant male figures around her

programme.title: Clean It, Fix It
programme.desc: Mark Wright and the team help foster carer Lyndee prepare her home for a new chapter, welcoming young mums and mums-to-be. Cleaner Maxine Dwyer deep cleans and restores order, while Mark and woodworker Derek Nesbeth rethink the rooms with soothing colours, space-saving furniture and clever storage. A handmade baby-changing unit, fold-down desk and Moses basket transform the larger room into a nursery, while the smaller bedroom becomes a peaceful retreat

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Taking on their most ambitious space to date, Amanda Holden and Alan Carr aim to turn the land at the front of the house that's used as the village car park into a bee-friendly Mediterranean garden. The duo want to make a feature out of their ancient olive tree and get their hands dirty building bespoke circular stone seating around the trunk. For a well-deserved break, Alan visits a beekeeper for a close encounter with the master pollinators and both he and Amanda head to a local beach at sunset for a swimming lesson with some rescue horses

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in the West Sussex countryside, with a £380,000 budget, helping Jane and Fabian leave London in search of a characterful cottage with a modest garden. Twenty years into married life, they're still clearly each other's favourite company, making this move every bit as exciting as the day they first met in New York. It's a fitting backdrop to a mystery house with echoes of a Manhattan loft apartment. Nicki also meets a couple of enterprising landlords growing much of the produce served on their pub's menu from the smallholding they've established nearby

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Uttoxeter, east Staffordshire, Shail and Cecilia long for a garden that reminds them of growing up in the countryside of India. However, the new-build garden they own is a featureless sloping plot. Lee Burkhill and Flo Headlam pool their efforts to create an entertainment space in the middle of the garden with a central patio featuring bespoke screesn and L-shaped benches. Lee adds a home-made tandoor for the family to cook together and a food prep area and vegetable growing beds. Flo mucks in with a planting area to draw attention from the giant walls and herb garden by the back door

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Antiques experts Margie Cooper and Ishy Khan are on the second leg of their road trip in their bright yellow Lamborghini Islero, this time cruising around Lincolnshire. Margie is intrigued by all thing eclectic from a mysterious coffee table to a feline print with a sporting twist, while Ishy is unable to resist silver

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Michael Ball

programme.title: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
programme.desc: Alan Carr pays tribute to Greek mythology by turning the landing into an intellectual reading room, while Amanda Holden embraces advanced technology for a Greek-themed bathroom. Away from the project, Alan whisks Amanda away for a tour of the iconic Achilleion Palace, built by the empress of Austria in 1880 as a shrine to the Greek gods. Alan meets local artist Olga to create some authentic Greek urns and unites with Amanda to enjoy a night out in Corfu Town to celebrate the island's annual Varkarola festival

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a retired couple from the Surrey town of Epsom and their five sausage dogs find a home with space for larger rescue animals. Rural drama, with David Lonsdale, Derek Fowlds and Philip Franks

With only one place left in the final, the pressure is on

programme.title: Emmerdale

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Carl falls under suspicion for stealing from the pub, Tim shares his suspicions of Richie with Lisa, Betsy returns to work, and Jodie effortlessly steps into Shona's domestic role

Arriving at the scene of an accident at the railway station, Dr Ormerod is forced to make a drastic decision, but an oncoming train signals disaster. Medical drama, starring Julian Ovenden, Robert Daws, Bill Maynard and Amy Robbins

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
programme.desc: Schoolgirl Jennifer Sutcliffe becomes embroiled in a mystery when priceless jewels are hidden among her belongings. The precious stones once belonged to a prince who fell foul of a revolution, and now his cousin is a pupil at the same school as Jennifer, where Poirot finds himself drawn into the unlikely situation and realises nothing is quite what it seems. David Suchet stars as the Belgian sleuth, with Harriet Walter and Claire Skinner

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Mike does his good deed for the year by reuniting an estranged family while investigating a puzzling spate of burglaries, and Ventress thinks he knows exactly how to stop Greengrass in his tracks - by arresting his faithful dog Alfred. Rural drama, starring Jason Durr, Bill Maynard, William Simons and Trevor Peacock

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: The detectives investigate two murders in which the victims have been placed in water and surrounded by flowers. Vera and sidekick Joe believe the culprit may be linked to a group of bird-watching friends, but despite their increasingly tangled and dysfunctional relationships, the twitchers seem determined to protect one another. The very first episode of the drama adapted from Ann Cleeves' novel Hidden Depths, starring Brenda Blethyn, David Leon, Gina McKee, Wunmi Mosaku, Paul Ritter and Neil Armstrong

programme.title: I Fought the Law: The Ann Ming Story
programme.desc: How Ann Ming, the grieving mother of Julie Hogg who was murdered in 1989, fought for 17 years to change England's 800-year-old double jeopardy law to ensure her daughter's killer was brought to justice. Plus, how her fight paved the way for other landmark convictions including Stephen Lawrence's killers. Narrated by Sheridan Smith

programme.title: Dark Heart
programme.desc: DI Will Wagstaffe and his team investigate the mysterious death of a young nurse on the London Underground. Whilst CCTV reveals the victim fleeing an invisible assailant, forensics find a DNA link to a missing teenager presumed dead for seven years. Aided by his new team DS Rob Mullan, DC Ray Monk, DC Annie Webb and pathologist Dr Luke Paul, Will unearths a bond of secrets and betrayals which leads him straight into the dark underbelly of the city. Starring Tom Riley, Anjli Mohindra and Jazon Maza

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories
programme.desc: The barrister examines two more real-life cases, including that of Darrell Simester, who was held against his will for 13 years on a farm in Newport, Wales. Plus, the case of Paul Roylance, who stole the money left to his mother Shelley when his father lost his life to cancer

programme.title: Heartbeat
programme.desc: Nick investigates the link between trespassers on the local railway line and thefts from a fur factory, culminating in a dramatic chase on board a moving train. Meanwhile, Greengrass acquires a metal detector and thinks he has struck gold - but someone else gets to it first. Nick Berry and Bill Maynard star

programme.title: Endeavour
programme.desc: The discovery of a 2,000-year-old body provides fresh evidence in a five-year-old unsolved missing persons case, so Morse and Thursday take up the investigation, discovering a possible link to a local pagan ritual to celebrate the harvest. The investigation leads them to a nuclear power station, where they face a conspiracy of silence concerning an experimental new reactor and a potential disaster that could devastate Oxford. Guest starring Sheila Hancock, widow of original Inspector Morse star John Thaw

programme.title: Posh Pawn

Meanwhile, a former Miss England wants to trade in her diamonds for a new life in the United States, and Lawrence gets excited when a Falklands veteran turns up with a piece of Prince Charles and Princess Diana's 34-year-old wedding cake

programme.title: The Royal

Medical drama, starring Julian Ovenden, Ian Carmichael, Robert Daws and Amy Robbins

Guest starring Jemima Rooper, Zoe Wanamaker and Peter Bowles, with David Suchet as the Belgian sleuth

Meanwhile, the duty solicitor assigned to the student uncovers new evidence that that changes the nature of the case entirely. Starring Tracy Ifeachor and Sinead Keenan
